children: Morocco's central bank kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 2.25% on Tuesday, saying current borrowing costs were in line with the inflation outlook, despite heightened global economic uncertainty.
Inflation will average 0.7% in 2026, following a drop in food prices, before ticking up to 1.7% next year, the bank said in a statement following its quarterly board meeting.
